$comment: EVERY ICON THE SYSTEM DRAWS, in one table. Nothing else carries a glyph: a control, a heading or a button names an icon, and this file decides what that name looks like. So the same mark is the same mark in the sidebar, the editor and the log window, and changing one is one edit here. A name that resolves to a glyph today can resolve to a file tomorrow, and nothing that uses the name has to change. Prefer a character: it takes the colour of the text around it, scales with the font, and needs no file. `at` is the code point, written for a person to search for.

power.for: start the engine, and stop it

plus.for: make something new. A regular plus, on the owner's word: the full-width one read as a different character

hand.for: the hold. A raised hand and the robot it stops, so what has stopped is on the button

gear.for: configuration. What is shown, and what a thing is set to

hammer.for: work. Not gears, which belong to configuration

pin.for: pin a group to the top, and unpin it

query.for: show the query behind a view

$log: What the log window puts beside a record. It reads this table too.
$types: What a column holds, said in one character. The editor draws one of these beside every property name.
